# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle: RED, GREEN (with retry), REFACTOR, and optional learning |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python: delegates code generation to WorkerAgent and execution to PodmanOrchestrator |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase (test, implementation, refactor) using LLM prompts |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment by asking the LLM what to write next |

| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant CLI as CLI (main.py)
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    User->>CLI: run_cycle.py
    CLI->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner

    loop for each cycle (max 12)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Planner: TestIncrement
        Planner-->>Runner: increment spec
        deactivate Planner

        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Note over Cycle: RED phase
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Worker: test code
        Worker-->>Pod: test code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: code})
        activate Orchestrator
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        activate Container
        Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult (failing)
        deactivate Container
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orchestrator
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod

        Note over Cycle: GREEN phase (with retries)
        loop up to max_green_attempts
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_feedback)
            activate Worker
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            LLM-->>Worker: implementation code
            Worker-->>Pod: implementation code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            activate Orchestrator
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
            activate Container
            Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
            deactivate Container
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orchestrator
            Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
            deactivate Pod
            alt green_result.passed
                break
            else
                Cycle->>Cycle: set error_feedback = green_result.output
            end
        end

        Note over Cycle: REFACTOR phase
        alt green_result.passed
            Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec, current_code)
            activate Worker
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            LLM-->>Worker: refactored code
            Worker-->>Pod: refactored code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file, refactored_impl})
            activate Orchestrator
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
            activate Container
            Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
            deactivate Container
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orchestrator
            Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
            deactivate Pod
        end

        Note over Cycle: Learning loop
        alt green_result.passed AND Reflector+Curator configured
            Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
            activate Reflector
            Reflector->>LLM: generate(analysis_prompt)
            LLM-->>Reflector: analysis
            Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
            deactivate Reflector

            Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            activate Curator
            Curator->>LLM: generate(synthesis_prompt)
            LLM-->>Curator: delta bullets
            Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
            activate Playbook
            Playbook-->>Curator: added bullet IDs
            deactivate Playbook
            Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
            deactivate Curator
        end

        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        activate Logger
        Logger-->>Cycle: logged
        deactivate Logger

        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle

        alt result.complete
            break
        end
    end

    Runner-->>CLI: IterativeResult
    deactivate Runner
    CLI-->>User: result summary
```
